h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Moradabad

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Moradabad

items.pText: Moradabad is India's brass city, and many of the people who buy playground equipment here know metal finishing better than most. They ask good questions about coatings, joints and rust. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,210 km away, and sends it to western Uttar Pradesh by road for schools, societies, clubs and parks.

We are happy to explain how our equipment is built before you buy. Share the site size, the age group and some photos, and we will suggest equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked. After you approve the layout and quote, we manufacture, dispatch and install through our own team or a dealer in north India.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

c: Painted mild steel looks fine on delivery, but once the paint is scratched, water reaches the bare metal and rust spreads under the coating. Galvanised steel is coated in zinc, which protects the steel even where the surface gets scratched. That is why our frames and posts are galvanised pipe, and why we give them a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects.

Slides, panels and seats are roto-moulded plastic made in our own facility, so they cannot rust at all. Moradabad's monsoon and damp winters are hard on poor finishes. Ask us about the materials used in any structure you shortlist, such as our

items.q: What is the difference between painted and galvanised steel?
items.a: Paint protects only while it is intact. Galvanised steel has a zinc coating that keeps protecting the metal even when the surface is scratched, so it resists rust much longer outdoors.

items.q: Do you make the plastic parts yourselves?
items.a: Yes. Design, roto-moulding and fabrication are done in-house at our Vasai factory, and every product goes through our own quality inspection.
Yes. We deliver by road and install through our own team or a dealer in north India, grouted or self-standing depending on your ground.
